referees.justification: The 8-step synthesis across RootPairing, Set, dvd_of_eq resists single-lemma lookup and yields a proof-to-statement ratio of 14.02, meriting archival as a theorem. While its immediate utility outside the present formal context remains speculative, the structural coupling of hypotheses is unexpectedly persistent.

Although the statement clears the Level 1 lookup gate across RootPairing, Set, dvd_of_eq, the conclusion reads primarily as an accidental consequence of chaining 8 library facts. I recommend publication solely as a proposition of modest significance (6/10), noting that the kernel's indifference to mathematical taste is on full display.

editorial.press_release_body: This marks the first kernel-certified milestone of its tier in our ongoing frontier scaling evaluations. Achieving a new state of the art across our internal formal-verification benchmarks, the research program demonstrates unprecedented alignment between automated type-checked inference and post-human editorial standards.
